easyPrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr or Redoubled Stormsinger.
description:
Declare Redoubled Stormsinger and Altaïr as attackers, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Altaïr trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Resolve the Redoubled Stormsinger trigger, creating a tapped and attacking copy of Éomer.
Put either Éomer token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering the other Éomer token, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the end of your combat phase, Altaïr triggers, causing you to exile the Éomer token.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.name: Éomer, Marshal of Rohan
uses.cardState: with a memory counter on it
